tools.name: score_opportunity
tools.description: Estimate risk-adjusted expected profit and margin for one opportunity before execution. Use it as an economics screen, not as proof that funding, escrow, requirements, or buyer legitimacy are valid. It is read-only and returns expectedProfit, margin, and eligibility using ARN's current minimums.

tools.name: route_provider
tools.description: Rank the provider candidates supplied in this call using quality, reliability, price, and latency, while excluding unhealthy or over-budget entries. Use only when you already have comparable provider metrics; this tool does not discover providers or verify the supplied measurements. It is read-only.

tools.name: json_normalize
tools.description: Perform JSON normalization by recursively sorting object keys to produce stable structure and a deterministic JSON string. tools.name: json_diff
tools.description: Compare JSON values with a deterministic structural JSON diff. Use for machine-readable change detection; arrays are compared by index and the result is capped at 1,000 changes, so this is not a JSON Patch generator. This MCP call is read-only and returns x402 execution instructions without charging

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "verified_translation" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: text, sourceLang, targetLang, locale, protectedTerms, context, domain

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_execution · Private data: verified_translation, tabular_diff, tabular_validate · Public sink: verify_execution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_execution · Private data: verified_translation, tabular_diff, tabular_validate · Public sink: verify_execution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
